# Shristyverse

> Shristyverse GK builds SHINRAI, a local-first AI platform. ISHIZUE runs models, agents and memory on hardware you control; KOBO plugins are in development.

Business: Development of SHINRAI, a local-first AI platform: ISHIZUE, an AI harness, and KOBO, specialist plugins for ISHIZUE.

- SHINRAI: From the Japanese word shinrai, trust. The platform as a whole: what we build so that organisations can rely on the AI they work with. ISHIZUE and KOBO are part of it.
- ISHIZUE: From ishizue, a foundation stone. The AI harness at the base. It brings models, routing, agents, memory and permissions together on hardware the organisation controls.
- KOBO: From kōbō, a workshop. The plugins we are building in our workshop, to do specialist work on ISHIZUE.

ISHIZUE is developer-preview software. Features marked in testing, in development, exploring or planned are not available yet.

Contact:

- Sales and partnerships: sales@shristyverse.com
- General: info@shristyverse.com
- Support: support@shristyverse.com

## English pages

- [Home](https://shristyverse.com/en/): Shristyverse GK builds SHINRAI, a local-first AI platform. ISHIZUE runs models, agents and memory on hardware you control; KOBO plugins are in development.
- [Products](https://shristyverse.com/en/products/): SHINRAI, the local-first AI platform, and its two parts: ISHIZUE, the AI harness, and KOBO, the plugins. Layers, set-ups, editions and the status of each part.
- [ISHIZUE](https://shristyverse.com/en/products/ishizue/): How ISHIZUE routes requests to models on an organisation’s own hardware, decides with an auditable engine, shares work between agents and lists its network use.
- [KOBO](https://shristyverse.com/en/products/kobo/): KOBO: six specialist plugins Shristyverse is building for ISHIZUE, for presentations, spreadsheets, Word documents, PDFs, website reviews and design.
- [Partners](https://shristyverse.com/en/partners/): Bring your AI product to organisations that cannot send their data to the cloud: it joins SHINRAI as an ISHIZUE plugin or an MCP server on their machines.
- [Company](https://shristyverse.com/en/company/): Shristyverse GK builds SHINRAI, a local-first AI platform with ISHIZUE and KOBO. Mission, company profile, the three names and how to reach us.
- [Contact](https://shristyverse.com/en/contact/): Write to Shristyverse GK about SHINRAI, ISHIZUE and KOBO: sales and partnerships, general questions, or support. There is no form.
